**Management Summary – Project LV €27,655**

The tender contains several specification gaps that inflate risk and may trigger change orders. High‑impact items: undefined installation depth and backfill for DN 150 pipe (€700) – immediate clarification required. Medium‑impact gaps total €4,306, notably missing concrete‑shaft details (€1,480), PE‑HD pressure class and pipe class (€576), formwork type/finish (€456), exposure class (€412), outdated concrete standard reference (€412), and absent site‑setup position (€274). Low‑impact issues (€570) involve missing reinforcement bar data and exposure class. Prioritize resolving the high‑ and medium‑severity deficiencies to secure accurate cost estimates, avoid delays, and ensure compliance with current standards.
